listSource: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (exophase.com/game/grand-theft-auto-vi-psn/trophies), checked 2026-11-19; names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them.
note: Guides are written in our own words for this entry. Each guide's source is named beside it. No trophy is confirmed missable from the official descriptions alone: story missions can be replayed, so the two finale-choice trophies are flagged 'choice' instead — make a manual save before the final mission.

stages.title: 1 · Story — Chapters 1–4 & the finale
stages.blurb: Play the story to the end. Every story trophy pops on its own; no side work needed.

stages.title: 2 · Strangers & side missions
stages.blurb: Strangers show as '?' on the map. Finish a strand, then move to the next.

stages.title: 3 · Activities & challenges
stages.blurb: Races, ranges, fishing, arcade, stunts. Your counts live in the pause menu's Stats.

stages.title: 4 · Heists & crime
stages.blurb: Vaults, trucks, shops and gang operations. Plan the exit before the entry.

stages.title: 5 · Collectibles & exploration
stages.blurb: Cards, WAiNK spots, vehicles, garages and the whole map of Leonida.

stages.title: 6 · Fun & secrets
stages.blurb: Bowling, cocktails, showrooms and the odd one out. The easy, funny cleanup.

stages.title: 7 · 100% Completion
stages.blurb: The pause menu's completion checklist. It counts almost everything above, so chase it last.

stages.title: 8 · Platinum
stages.blurb: Earn the other 54 trophies. It unlocks on its own the moment the last one pops.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies; the platinum unlocks on its own the moment the last one pops. Work the roadmap stages in order — story first, then 100%, then cleanup.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first story mission; the trophy pops when it ends.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its end. Story only — no side work needed.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2 to its end. Story only — no side work needed.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 3 to its end. Story only — no side work needed.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 4 to its end. Story only — no side work needed.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. Before you start it, make a manual save — the two choice trophies below branch from the finale.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the story.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the heist mission The Cartel Heist. It is a story heist — it unlocks as the story reaches it.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the pause menu's completion checklist. It counts story, activities, collectibles and side content together — most of this guide's other trophies feed it, so chase it last and use the checklist to see what is left.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; in-game completion checklist (pause menu)

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are the game's stunt jumps and driving feats; your count is tracked in Stats. Chain them during free roam instead of hunting them one by one.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; in-game Stats

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every activity type once — races, shooting range, fishing, arcade, drone races and the rest. Open the Activities menu and work down the list; one try each is enough.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; in-game Activities menu

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold-medal every Shooting Range challenge. Learn each range's scoring first, then run them until gold; the range tracks your best medal per challenge.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; in-game Shooting Range

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of its locations. Learn each course's corners before racing for the win.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race counts once, so spread your wins across race types and locations instead of repeating one.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Challenge Cal to a fishing challenge and beat him. Fishing challenges happen at fishing spots; the best catch wins.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any arcade game to its end. Pick the shortest one first.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand — play his missions until his final one completes.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand through to his final mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand through to his final mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across the state. Strangers appear as '?' on the map; finish a strand, then move to the next — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone are five of them.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand through to his final mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand through to his final mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Find every meditation spot across Leonida and meditate at each. Meditation spots are quiet scenic points — look for them as you explore the map.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Follow Bret's strand and take the shot when the animal appears.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida; a finished set is all the cards of one set — track which sets you are close on and finish those first.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK it at 100 locations. WAiNK spots are marked as you explore; your count is tracked in Stats — sweep one region at a time.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; in-game Stats

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges span driving, combat, exploration and activities; your count is tracked in Stats — pick off the easy ones first.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; in-game Stats

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, reach a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Use open ground and fast cars; breaking line of sight is what drops the stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without losing your wanted level. Plan a route of three close shops, keep the getaway car ready, and do not let the heat drop between robberies.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. A vehicle counts the first time you get in one — your count is tracked in Stats; try every car, bike, boat and plane you pass.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; in-game Stats

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: In one Combat Focus, take down 5 enemies. Start it with a group in front of you and chain the kills before the focus ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave VCIA airport without following the schedule — take a plane and get airborne from the airport on your own terms.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Find a Rhino tank and cause chaos with it. The description is a joke, not a step list — expect the trophy to trigger from sustained Rhino action, so drive it into trouble and survive the heat.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, avoid cameras and guards' sightlines, and leave before the alarm.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Plan the exit before the entry; five successful vault jobs, not five attempts.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Stop the truck, grab the cash, and lose the heat before it builds.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore every part of Leonida. Your map fills in as you travel; the trophy pops when the whole state is uncovered — drive the highways and back roads, do not just fast-travel.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation of every gang in Leonida. Each gang has its own operations; hit one per gang.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Order a cocktail at a bar with a view on Ocean Beach and enjoy it. A quiet moment — find the right bar on the beachfront.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash a vehicle out through a showroom's front in classic GTA style — drive it straight through the glass.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bowl at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through. Play a full game there.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Build your partnership's appeal to its peak. The description is deliberately vague; expect it to track your partner activities and public standing — keep doing partner content and it should land.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make the story choices in the finale. This one branches from a decision — make a manual save before the final mission so you can see both branches.
trophies.missableNote: Tied to a finale choice — manual-save before the final mission.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Try the finale's choice a second time — it pops when the same choice plays out differently on a replay. Replay the final mission after your first ending.
trophies.missableNote: Needs a second play of the finale choice — manual-save before the final mission.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Find the game's strangest secret — the description is the joke. Expect an easter egg or an odd encounter somewhere in Leonida; watch the community's secret-hunting threads for the spot once the game is out.
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; community secret-hunting threads (as they appear)

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock pins over with a melee drive-by — swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle into a bowling setup.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from heists and robberies; your contacts wash them for clean cash — the total is cumulative.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, food, anything. The total is cumulative and counts every shop in Leonida.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property in Leonida. Your property list shows which ones you own; buy the rest.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find a vehicle, open the app, and register it — ten different vehicles.
